svg.text: Tags with the same name are one connection. The cutoff relay (K1) and the SSR switch the heater hot lead in series:
K1 is closed only while the firmware allows heat, so a shorted SSR is still cut off.
LOW VOLTAGE · ESP32 protoboard and sensors
RJ45 screw adapter at sensor end
R1, R2 keep SSR and relay off while the ESP32 boots
IN ← GPIO26 · AC in series after K1
GPIO26 to GND (SSR off at boot)
GPIO27 to GND (relay off at boot)
VIN to GND at the GY-906 end of the Cat6
Relay shield: power 5V/GND, touch D1 to 3V3:
it should click and its LED light.
Meter COM–NO: open with the shield unpowered,
closed when D1 is high. Do this before any
SSR input polarity: 3 (+) to GPIO26, 4 (−) to
Mains (C14, K1 terminals, SSR AC side) never
Bench test with a lamp before the heat panel.
SDA/SCL are shared by the OLED, SHT30 and IR sensor (I2C at 50 kHz); their boards supply the pull-ups. The DS18B20 adapters carry their own 4.7k pull-ups.
An optional upstream failsafe (ZEN04 or ITC-308) plugs in between the wall and the C14 cord; see BUILD.md.
